Đọc rồi thay chi tiết cho đúng trải nghiệm của bạn.
samples.summaryVi: Cân bằng chơi game cần thỏa thuận thời gian thực tế và giữ trách nhiệm học, ngủ, vận động.

sections.label: Trò chơi điện tử

questions.question: Are you interested in video games in free time?
questions.answer: Yes, I am, mainly because players can enjoy a hobby while still making time for other needs. I would like to understand how this works in everyday life, rather than just read a definition.
questions.noteVi: Trả lời trực tiếp → thêm một lý do.

questions.question: How could you learn more about video games in free time?
questions.answer: I could join a balanced gaming discussion. There, I would have a chance to plan a weekly routine that includes games and other activities. Trying something with other people usually helps me remember it.
questions.noteVi: Nêu một cách tìm hiểu và hoạt động cụ thể.

questions.question: Is there anything difficult about video games in free time?
questions.answer: One possible difficulty is that an unrealistic rule may lead to arguments rather than better habits. For example, a parent may demand an immediate stop in the middle of a team game that was arranged in advance. I think it is better to recognise that problem early.
questions.noteVi: Một khó khăn → một ví dụ, không liệt kê quá nhiều.

sections.label: Kế hoạch cuối tuần & học cùng bạn bè

questions.question: What would you like to do with a friend this weekend?
questions.answer: I would like to plan a weekly routine that includes games and other activities. We could bring a weekly timetable and compare what we learn. It would give us something useful to talk about afterwards.
questions.noteVi: Nêu kế hoạch, đồ cần mang và lợi ích.

questions.question: Do you prefer learning something alone or with friends?
questions.answer: For a new topic, I prefer being with one or two friends. For instance, if we were learning about video games in free time, we could ask each other questions. However, I like reviewing my notes alone afterwards.
questions.noteVi: Chọn một phía, thêm tình huống và một ngoại lệ.

questions.question: How do you decide whether an activity is worth your time?
questions.answer: I ask whether I can use what I learn. In this case, it would be helpful to know how to agree on realistic finishing times and responsibilities before play begins. I also check the time and cost before making a plan.
questions.noteVi: Một tiêu chí → áp dụng vào tình huống → chi tiết thêm.
